summary: Default auth login uses tesla_auth (not dead void-callback), fleet-register persists key path, resolveFleetKeyPath/locateRelayPrivateKey fallback to ~/.tesla/*-private.pem, compactFields strips cached_data/tokens/backseat_token, error strings use clone+build (not @latest), docs lead with working flows.
reason: Tesla's OAuth rejects void-callback redirect_uri (404). fleet-register never persisted PrivateKeyPath. Error strings told users 'go install @latest' which fails due to upstream replace directives. Products --agent dumped huge cached_data protobuf. locateRelayPrivateKey hardcoded a personal car name. Docs taught the dead paste flow and used personal car names.
validated_outcome: Module build/vet/test pass (310 cli tests). Default auth login uses tesla_auth or errors with install instructions. Fleet-register accepts --key-file and auto-detects from ~/.tesla/. resolveFleetKeyPath and locateRelayPrivateKey fall back to any *-private.pem in ~/.tesla/. Error strings give clone+build instructions. compactFields strips cached_data/tokens/backseat_token. Docs use generic <name>/<VIN> placeholders, correct key paths, and working flows.
